title: Oceanic Golden British Seafood Fritters
description: A flexitarian-friendly British dish featuring frozen seafood mix, deep-fry cooked to a jammy and chewy texture, perfect for a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, salt, and pepper.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs and milk.
Add the thawed seafood mix to the egg mixture and stir to combine.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined, being careful not to overmix.
Heat the vegetable oil in a deep frying pan or a comal to 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the seafood mixture into the hot oil.
Fry the fritters for 3-4 minutes on each side, or until golden brown and cooked through.
Remove the fritters from the oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels.
Serve the fritters hot with lemon wedges on the side.
